questions.question: What did Ezekiel see flowing from the temple in chapter 47?
options: A host of bright angels, ascending from the gate
A cloud of glory, filling the inner court
A pillar of fire, rising above the altar
A river of water, flowing from the threshold
questions.answer: A river of water, flowing from the threshold

questions.question: What happened to the water as it flowed, and what did it bring?
options: It turned bitter and could not be drunk
It dried up quickly under the burning sun
It flooded the land and swept away the city
It grew deeper and brought life and healing
questions.answer: It grew deeper and brought life and healing

questions.question: On the banks of the river grew trees whose leaves were for healing and which bore fruit monthly.
Water was issuing from below the threshold of the temple toward the _____.
Wherever the river flows, everything will _____.
